# Adediran Adeyemi

> Freelance data scientist and AI/ML engineer specializing in e-commerce and retail analytics. Based in Lagos, Nigeria, working remotely worldwide. Focus areas: churn prediction, cart abandonment analytics, customer lifetime value modeling, inventory forecasting, Power BI dashboards, and NLP/RAG systems.

Adediran Adeyemi helps e-commerce, retail, and SaaS businesses turn transactional and behavioral data into production machine learning systems and dashboards that drive measurable revenue outcomes. 5+ years of experience, 50+ dashboards built, 20+ models deployed to production, 80+ projects delivered.
